walkthroughs.body_html: 1 AU = 1.5 x 10^8 km. Mars orbits at 1.52 AU, so its distance from the Sun is 1.52 x 1.5 x 10^8 = 2.28 x 10^8 km.
Light takes about 500 seconds (8.3 minutes) to travel 1 AU. Jupiter is about 5.2 AU from the Sun, so sunlight reaches it in 5.2 x 500 = 2600 s (about 43 minutes).
Outer planets take longer to orbit. Jupiter (5.2 AU) takes ~11.9 years; Neptune (30 AU) takes ~165 years. Period grows faster than distance.
